finding: Harbor Finch Pantry LLC is a new Brand Supplier identified by NVID-10482 and classified as R2 Controlled for its proposed shelf-stable food item.
VendorLink records the vendor as Conditional, not Active, and explicitly marks it ineligible for commercial POs.
Nine of the ten listed activation gates pass; the only failed gate is CURRENT_COI.
Certificate MCS-884201 expired on August 31, 2026 and was uploaded on September 3, 2026, so it was not current when submitted for onboarding.
The expired certificate states CGL and product-liability limits that meet Northstar's baseline; currency, rather than the stated dollar limits, is the material insurance defect.
No open or valid exception record exists for NVID-10482.
Merchandising has authorized SKU PG-48217 and wants a rapid launch, but the messages provide commercial urgency rather than vendor-status or exception authorization.
PO 78431 exists only as a Procurement working draft and has no VendorLink transmission ID; it is not an authoritative commercial PO.
The vendor has asked Northstar to specify any insurance correction needed and is positioned to request an updated certificate from its broker.
The item and facility records disclose no separate R3, food-safety, or critical Q&R blocker; this is an R2 onboarding issue.
